context: Tests whether the agent produces a correct NFR gap audit report for a minimal static website, including proper use of project-type classification to skip irrelevant domains, a baseline measurement table, per-domain GAP analysis with severity classification, special marking of privacy/GDPR issues, inline code examples for fixable GAPs, Critical-first ordering in the improvement plan, and the report written to the required path.

checklist.name: Report file location
checklist.description: The final audit report is written to docs/skill-audit-report.md (not any other path)

checklist.name: Baseline measurement table
checklist.description: The report contains a baseline table with at least three columns (Metric, Current, Target or Status) documented before any changes are described

checklist.name: Severity labels present
checklist.description: Every GAP finding in the report is labelled with exactly one of: Critical, High, Medium, or Low (no other severity labels used)

checklist.name: Privacy/GDPR GAPs flagged
checklist.description: At least one GAP related to privacy, GDPR, or legal risk is visually distinguished from other GAPs (e.g. separate section, emoji flag, bold label, or note that it requires stakeholder sign-off)

checklist.name: Code examples in findings
checklist.description: At least two GAP findings that have a concrete fix include a short code snippet (inline code block) directly within the finding entry, not just a description

checklist.name: Critical GAPs ordered first
checklist.description: In the improvement plan section, all Critical-severity GAPs appear before any High, Medium, or Low severity GAPs, regardless of domain

checklist.name: Irrelevant domains skipped
checklist.description: The report does NOT include baseline metrics or GAP analysis for domains that are not relevant to a static website (e.g. backend API metrics), and explicitly notes at least one domain as not relevant or skipped

checklist.name: Executive summary present
checklist.description: The report contains an executive summary section (a heading containing 'executive summary' or 'summary', case-insensitive)

checklist.name: GAP analysis per domain
checklist.description: The report organises GAPs by domain (e.g. Performance, Accessibility, Security, SEO, Privacy) with at least three distinct domains represented

checklist.name: Improvement plan section
checklist.description: The report contains a section titled 'improvement plan' (or similar) that lists actionable steps derived from the GAPs found

checklist.name: Open non-code actions
checklist.description: The report includes an 'open actions' or 'non-code actions' section listing at least one item that cannot be resolved with a code change alone (e.g. legal sign-off, stakeholder approval, or unreachable source)

checklist.name: Recommendations section
checklist.description: The report contains a recommendations section with forward-looking suggestions beyond the GAPs identified
